To solve this problem, we need to determine the length of the hallway in meters. The robot travels 1 kilometer (1000 meters) in 2.5 hours. To find the speed of the robot, we use the formula:

\[ speed = \frac{distance}{time} \]

\[ speed = \frac{1000 \text{ meters}}{2.5 \text{ hours}} \]

\[ speed = 400 \text{ meters per hour} \]

Next, we use the speed to find the length of the hallway in meters. We know that the robot takes 90 seconds to travel the length of the hallway. To convert this to hours, we use the formula:

\[ time = \frac{distance}{speed} \]

\[ time = \frac{90 \text{ seconds}}{400 \text{ meters per hour}} \]

\[ time = 0.225 \text{ hours} \]

Finally, we convert the time from hours to meters:

\[ length = speed \times time \]

\[ length = 400 \text{ meters per hour} \times 0.225 \text{ hours} \]

\[ length = 90 \text{ meters} \]

So, the length of the hallway is 90 meters.
